title: At the time of sunset
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا اقْبَالُ لَيْلِكَ وَادْبَارُ نَهَارِكَ وَأَصْوَاتُ دُعَاتِكَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي
translation: O Allah, this is the approaching of Your night and the disappearing of Your day and the sounds of those who pray to You. So do forgive me.

title: When seeing the moon
arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الْغَاسِقِ
translation: I seek the protection of Allah from the evil of this darkening moon.

title: At the time of drought
translation: O Allah, quench our thirst. O Allah, send us rain.

title: When there is excessive rain
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الْأَكَامِ وَالْأَجَامِ وَالطَّرَابِ وَالْأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
translation: O Allah, send rain around us, not upon us. O Allah, make it rain upon the hills, in the woods, on the mountains, in the valleys, and in the places where trees grow.

title: Dua when leaving a gathering
arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
translation: Glory be to Allah with His praises. Glory be to You, O Allah, with Your praises. I bear witness that there is no god besides You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

title: When entering a shopping centre
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
translation: There is no god besides Allah. He is One. He has no partner. His is the kingdom and for Him is all praise. He gives life and causes death. He is Ever-Living and never dies. In His hand is all good. And He has power over everything.
